correctness.rationale: Positive definiteness follows from the exact Fourier symbol q>=1/4. The scalar DARE is solved explicitly; completion-of-squares gives an identity valid for every stable noncirculant static gain. Both stationary covariance and I+P dominate the identity; graph-band Frobenius orthogonal projection gives a universal lower bound. The nearest outer Laurent branch is -2, with square-root coefficient sqrt3 and no other singularity at that modulus; transfer yields the exact Fourier tail constant 1/(2pi). A stable symmetric finite-range truncation gives matching uniform upper order. Numerically reproduced with the embedded check.py; infinite statements rely on the proof.

value.rationale: A sharp locality performance lower bound identifies a physical communication constraint that general upper tail bounds cannot certify. The exact exponential base 4 and polynomial cubic improvement resolve the asymptotic static communication-radius price for a natural SPD nearest-neighbor state-cost chain, while permitting all possibly noncirculant static gains. It yields a precise second-order logarithmic design-radius law and a reproducible benchmark for sharper distributed LQR analysis.
